A revisit and a non-zero accumulator are the same event seen two ways, so revisits == 0 must agree with that. FAILS if revisits > 0 here while the old shape read nonzero == 0 on the same titles -- the two cannot both be right, and the detector's off-comparison would be the suspect, specifically the ma_prev_off reset on the last slice.
